    Profile

    Tsukuyomi is a samurai who was summoned from the world of Zipangu who never loses her smile. She possesses immense power and absolutely adores her siblings—anyone who mocks the dolls made in their likeness will face imminent destruction.

    Origin: Zipangu
    Gender: Female
    Height: 155cm
    Weight: 48kg
    Birthday: Sep 29
    Blood Type: ―
    Zodiac: Libra
    Likes: Her siblings
    Hobbies: Playing with her dolls
    Illust: しぶ彦
    CV: 伊瀬茉莉也
